title: The Yen Carry Trade, Mapped
summary: ¥13.4tn of identifiable yen-denominated debt across 547 instruments — 384 JASDEC Samurai bonds and 163 SEC-reported facilities. An interactive map of the maturity wall, funding costs, rate benchmarks and disclosed underwriting behind the yen carry trade.
